components.name: Text field
components.description: Explicit visible labels and quiet native input treatment.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;font:400 13px/1.5 "Manrope","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#656b65)}.ds-field input{font:400 14px/1.5 "Manrope","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;min-height:40px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--control-line,#a8aea6);border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#202522);caret-color:var(--primary,#167345)}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#9099a4}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #21804e;outline-offset:2px;border-color:var(--primary,#167345)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#656b65)}

components.name: Application navigation
components.description: Underlined sections in a warm-paper horizontal header.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:stretch;padding:12px 20px;background:var(--canvas,#f7f6f1)}.ds-nav button{font:500 13px/1.5 "Manrope","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;padding:8px 2px;min-height:42px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#656b65);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{border-bottom-color:var(--text,#202522);color:var(--text,#202522)}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--text,#202522)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #21804e;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Graphite assessment
components.description: The primary dark focal region; sample value is illustrative component content.
components.css: .ds-assessment{padding:24px;background:#202522;color:#f5f3ec;font-family:"Manrope","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif}.ds-assessment header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:12px}.ds-assessment header span+span{color:#b6beb8}.ds-assessment p{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin:20px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-assessment strong{font:500 76px/1 "Oswald","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-assessment p>span{font-size:13px;color:#b6beb8}.ds-assessment button{padding:10px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid #444c46;border-radius:0;width:100%;text-align:left;font:500 13px/1.5 "Manrope","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;color:#8bdd9b;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-assessment button:hover{background:#374238}.ds-assessment button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8bdd9b;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A user-approved MOONDROP-informed visual direction brings expressive Manrope and Oswald typography to a functional conversation reviewer. A warm-paper source faces a graphite assessment; the full-width dialogue index and light forms stay clear and operational.
keyCharacteristics: Manrope body and Oswald headings and scores

rules.name: Source stays inspectable
rules.body: Evidence always returns to the original quote or checked range, preserving source position and criterion focus.

rules.name: Meaningful color
rules.body: Deep green acts on light surfaces; pale green acts on graphite. Warm paper, cream and sage keep the source and assessment distinct. Critical and warning states preserve their own meaning.

rules.name: Flat working surface
rules.body: Separate source and assessment through a deliberate light/dark split, alignment and rules. Keep ordinary surfaces flat and reserve elevation for overlays.

dos: Use real conversation data and actual status counts.
Keep score and gross-error flags independent.
Preserve version-bound drafts and original assessments.
Respect reduced motion and keyboard focus.
donts: Do not restore the permanently visible three-column queue.
Do not reintroduce the rejected pale-green card scaffold.
Do not invent confidence, progress or audio capabilities.
Do not restore the rejected neutral navigation rail or extend the graphite palette to every screen.
